title: Project
tagline: DeFi lending protocol backed by real asset that generates revenues in the real world
description: A DeFi lending protocol backed by real assets is an innovative financial platform that combines the advantages of blockchain technology with the stability and security of real-world assets. This emerging concept aims to bridge the gap between traditional finance and the decentralized world of cryptocurrencies, offering a range of benefits and opportunities for both borrowers and lenders.
how_its_made: Creating a DeFi lending protocol backed by real assets involves a combination of blockchain technology, smart contracts, tokenization, and various software development processes. Conceptualization and Planning, Tokenization of Real Assets, Smart Contract Development, UI Developments, liquidity management, compliance.
